svg.title: FloorSync — Transactional Outbox

text.tspan: Durable simulation changes · Publish after commit · Retry missed publication
One database transaction · event, projection and notification commit together
Publish to Redis, then mark sent
Claim due rows: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
Redis unavailable: record failure and retry
Rollback writes neither the event nor the outbox notice.
A publish / mark race can repeat a notification.
Redis acceptance is not a browser delivery acknowledgement.
